tasks.label: ESP-IDF Clean stale OpenOCD
tasks.command: pkill -f openocd || true; for p in 3333 4444 6666; do PIDS=$(lsof -tiTCP:$p 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$PIDS" ] && kill -9 $PIDS || true; done; pkill -f riscv32-esp || true

tasks.label: ESP-IDF Build ESP32-C5
tasks.command: cd "${workspaceFolder}" && . /Users/zhiqin/.espressif/v5.5.4/esp-idf/export.sh && export PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:/opt/homebrew/sbin:$PATH" && idf.py set-target esp32c5 && idf.py build

tasks.label: ESP-IDF Clean Build ESP32-C5
tasks.command: cd "${workspaceFolder}" && . /Users/zhiqin/.espressif/v5.5.4/esp-idf/export.sh && export PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:/opt/homebrew/sbin:$PATH" && rm -rf build && idf.py set-target esp32c5 && idf.py build

tasks.label: ESP-IDF Flash ESP32-C5
tasks.command: cd "${workspaceFolder}" && . /Users/zhiqin/.espressif/v5.5.4/esp-idf/export.sh && export PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:/opt/homebrew/sbin:$PATH" && PORT=$(ls /dev/cu.usbmodem* 2>/dev/null | head -n 1) && [ -n "$PORT" ] && idf.py -p "$PORT" flash
